Description: Alps EC11E Vertical Rotary Encoder w/ Push Switch
1x2P 2.54mm Jumper (Short to connect EC11_B to GPIO20)
1x6P 2.54mm Male Header (Oscilloscope / Logic Analyzer Test Points)
4.7k 1/4W I2C SCL Pull-up (DNP if RTC has pull-up)
4.7k 1/4W I2C SDA Pull-up (DNP if RTC has pull-up)
ESP32-C3 SuperMini Module (plug into U1_L/U1_R, USB-C UP)
